draft.headline: NVIDIA launched RTX Spark compact desktops from ASUS, Dell, and MSI featuring up to 128GB of unified memory.
draft.threads_post:
NVIDIA RTX Spark compact desktops from ASUS, Dell, and MSI are available today.

The dedicated Windows PCs feature up to 128GB of unified memory to run local AI models. NVIDIA says the systems support local AI agents, image and video generation, and model fine-tuning alongside creative tools.

Would you run local AI workflows on a dedicated desktop, or stay in the cloud?
